verdicts.reason: A keeps a readable left-to-right banner with a large logo, the can, a clear headline and the CTA, but the flavour list is broken up: Cherry Bang is enlarged and centred, three flavours sit in a tiny row, Lime Zap is stranded above the CTA, Lime Zap and Grape Pop are out of order, and the logo is jammed against the left edge. B is worse: the logo is shrunk to an illegible pill, the flavour items appear at wildly different sizes (Lime Zap and Mango Boom are huge, Grape Pop and Cherry Bang are tiny) and are scattered across the canvas out of order, and Lime Zap and Mango Boom compete with the headline.
